comments.text: The free look period for health insurance in India is 15–30 days from the date of policy issuance. During this period, you can cancel your policy and receive a refund of almost 100% of the premium amount. However, the insurer will deduct the premium for the number of days you were covered, as well as any costs incurred for stamp duty and medical tests.

comments.text:
To cancel a health insurance policy, you can follow these steps:
1. Contact the insurer
Get in touch with your health insurance provider's support team to start the cancellation process. 
 
2. Submit a written request
Send a written request to your insurer either online or offline. The request should include your policy details and the reason for cancellation. 
 
3. Wait for a response
The insurer will likely contact you to address your reason for cancellation. 
 
4. Initiate the cancellation
If you still want to cancel, the insurer will start the cancellation process. 
 
5. Receive a refund
The insurer will deduct any applicable charges from your refund and send it to your registered bank account. You should receive a notification about the refund via email, message, or letter. 
 
Some health insurance providers offer a cancellation form that you can fill out during the free-look period.
